Dashboard for E-commerce

Product Design
Unreleased Project

Overview

The iPure Herbs Admin Dashboard is an internal operations tool designed to help the business manage orders, inventory, and sales performance in one place. Built for internal staff rather than end customers, it prioritizes clarity and speed over visual flourish — surfacing the numbers and actions the team needed most, at a glance.

Services

Product Design UX Design Data Visualization Design System

Problem

Before this dashboard, daily operations relied on scattered spreadsheets and manual cross-checking to track sales, orders, and product stock. This made it slow and error-prone for staff to answer basic operational questions — what's selling, what needs reordering, and which orders need attention — in real time.

Challenge

The business needed a single, reliable view of daily operations without requiring staff to jump between systems. The challenge was to design a dashboard dense enough to be genuinely useful for daily decision-making - surfacing sales, order status, and product/stock data — without becoming overwhelming or hard to scan quickly.

Role

Sole designer responsible for the dashboard's UX and visual system — from information architecture and data hierarchy to chart design and component design across the dashboard, order management, and product screens.

  • Identified the core daily questions staff needed answered fast (sales today, stock alerts, pending vs. delivered orders, product performance) and prioritized those across three core views
  • Designed a clear visual hierarchy separating at-a-glance metrics (sales, orders, customers, margin) from deeper drill-down views (revenue trends, order breakdowns, product-level data)
  • Used color coding (delivered, processing, pending, returned) to make order status scannable without reading every row
  • Structured the product screen around inventory visibility and stock-level clarity, supporting faster reorder decisions
  • Built a reusable component system (cards, tables, status tags) to keep dashboard, order, and product screens visually consistent
Hold to pause · drag to explore

Design System

Design work covered the core dashboard, order management, and product screens before the project was discontinued due to issues on the client's side. Additional modules — customer management and detailed reporting — were scoped but not reached before the project ended. The work established a clear, scalable pattern for internal tool design: prioritize speed and clarity first, since operational dashboards succeed when staff can act on information in seconds.
